candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 to gateway /v1/orders and /v1/checkout, producing the observed 502 checkout responses.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 as proximate failure; the underlying payment-side cause (config, resource, dependency) is not observed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with payment 503s on /v1/authorizations across all sampled traces; order returns 502 upstream. Gateway metrics show ~10.7 502s on /v1/checkout in 60s. Payment-side root cause remains unobserved.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics for /v1/authorizations 503 root cause
Order service logs confirming 502 propagation path
